name: get_unchecked
declaration: unsafe fn get_unchecked (self , slice : * const T) -> * const Self :: Output
documentation:
Returns a pointer to the output at this location, without
 performing any bounds checking.

 Calling this method with an out-of-bounds index or a dangling `slice` pointer
 is *[undefined behavior]* even if the resulting pointer is not used.

 [undefined behavior]: https://doc.rust-lang.org/reference/behavior-considered-undefined.html
rules: The index `self` must be in bounds for `slice` when calling `get_unchecked`; an out-of-bounds index causes undefined behavior even if the returned pointer is not used.
The `slice` pointer must not be dangling when calling `get_unchecked`; a dangling `slice` pointer causes undefined behavior even if the returned pointer is not used.
